description: The plot illustrates how BLEU score varies with Average Lagging (AL) for four training/testing context-consistency conditions. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” on a linear scale, spanning approximately from 1 to 8, with major tick labels shown at 2-unit intervals (2, 4, 6, 8). The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” on a linear scale, ranging roughly from 20 to 30, with labeled ticks every 2 BLEU (20, 22, 24, 26, 28, 30). Four lines are shown: (1) “Consistency-CE” is a light purple dashed line with circular markers, rising from about 20.1 BLEU at AL≈1 to about 29.7 at AL≈8, increasing steadily with intermediate points around 25.2 at AL≈3, 27.4 at AL≈4, and ~29.0 at AL≈6. (2) “Inconsistency-CE” is a darker purple dashed line with square markers, increasing from about 22.3 at AL≈1 to about 29.8 at AL≈8, with intermediate values around ~26.6 at AL≈3, ~28.4 at AL≈4, and ~29.4 at AL≈6. (3) “Inconsistency-CE-MP” is a blue dashed line with square markers, rising from about 22.3 at AL≈1 to about 29.5 at AL≈8, with intermediate points around ~26.2 at AL≈3, ~27.9 at AL≈4, and ~28.9 at AL≈6. (4) “Consistency-Bi” is a red solid line with star markers, increasing from about 24.9 at AL≈1 to about 30.1 at AL≈8, with intermediate values around ~27.2 at AL≈3, ~29.0 at AL≈4, and ~29.8 at AL≈6; all four series show an upward progression across the AL range shown.
